cs.t: I used to use a Jabra freestanding mic/speaker, and it's still a great choice -- they have excellent separation and no echo problem at all. I recently upgraded to a Logitech BCC950 freestanding conference camera, and it is also excellent. Note that both of these solutions are much more expensive than an ordinary headset or webcam (~£200 range).  https://secure.logitech.com/en-gb/product/conferencecam-bcc9...
